svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Overplotting hides the distribution and keeps the outliers
Left: the centre is solid ink. The viewer's impression of where the mass sits is formed by ink opacity, not by data.
Right: density is explicit and quantified, and the price spikes are restored as their own layer.
